summary: Fill the runtime-bridges stub surface with bridge policies for Supabase (OB1 MCP) and the new Telegram bot runtime, including session scoping and flush rules.
rationale: The runtime-bridges surface has been a stub since initialization. The Telegram bot introduces a second runtime bridge alongside Supabase. Without a governed bridge policy, there are no rules for how Telegram session state maps to Supabase memory, when conversation context is flushed, or how long a 'session' window is. This surface defines those rules so the bot and memory-auditor both operate on the same model.
proposed_diff_summary: Create users/cici/governed-state/runtime-bridges/policy.json with two bridge entries: supabase (type: mcp-memory, role: primary-runtime, endpoint_env: OB1_MCP_URL, key_env: OB1_MCP_KEY, sync_rules: governed-state always overrides runtime) and telegram (type: chat-interface, role: user-facing, session_window_minutes: 60, conversation_durability_class: telegram-conversation, auto_capture: true, flush_on: session_end_or_timeout). Promote runtime-bridges surface from stub to active in surface-map.json.
